sdk.windows_distribution: source-build; official 0.10.0 Windows ZIP does not include Vulkan

generated_candidate.compatibility_with_official_sdk: reference only: ppc/ is XenonRecomp output and does not build against the ReXGlue ABI; generate rex/generated/default from your own default.xex instead

codegen.origin: the working iOS port of this same game (Player124413/SonicGenerations-iOS): same manifest, same setjmp/longjmp addresses, same midasm hooks
codegen.how: rexglue codegen sonicgenerations_manifest.toml, run from rex/ (docs/REXGLUE_WINDOWS.md)

plume.why: the native renderer's RHI (docs/NATIVE_RENDERING.md): one Vulkan backend for a Win32 HWND and an Android ANativeWindow*, so the renderer is written once for both ports
plume.how: git submodule update --init --recursive thirdparty/plume (its contrib/volk, Vulkan-Headers and VulkanMemoryAllocator are needed)
